blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Video generation models are increasingly evaluated as visual reasoners: given a first frame and a natural-language prompt, can the model produce the video in which the specified task is carried out? The paradigm is considered advantageous because the reasoning is native to the visual medium, unfolding directly in the frames rather than through language or code. Whether this native route is in fact the more reliable path to visual reasoning has not been tested against a symbolic alternative under the same conditions. We therefore pose the same tasks, with identical inputs, output specification and evaluator, to both media: rather than denoising pixels, a coding agent writes a program that renders the answer video, which an unmodified rule-based evaluator scores. On VBVR-Pro-Bench (Xu et al., 2026), a 500-instance suite spanning five cognitive categories with symbolic ground truth, the agent receives the same first frame and prompt as the video model, with no access to ground truth, metadata or generation models, and one attempt per instance. Three closed-model agents (Codex with gpt-6-astra, Claude Code with Fable 5.1 and Gemini CLI with Gemini 3.1 Pro) score 0.923, 0.894 and 0.893, each more than 0.22 above the strongest video model. Among 23 runnable open-weight models, the best, GLM-5, reaches 0.572, above all video models except the RL-trained one. Together, we show that for tasks whose solutions can be computed from a first frame and a prompt, program synthesis is currently a substantially more reliable route to visual reasoning than video generation. We further distinguish depictive programs, which navigate the image to recover a transferable scheme, from propositional programs, which operate on hard-coded values, revealing how visual reasoning unfolds in agent-written programs and what it implies for its nature of reasoning in general.
blocks.zh: 视频生成模型越来越多地被评价为视觉理性:鉴于第一个帧和自然语言的提示,该模型能否产生执行所指定任务的视频? 范式被认为是有利的,因为推理是视觉介质的本能,直接在框架而不是通过语言或代码进行. 实际上,这种本土路线是否是视觉推理的更可靠途径,还没有在同样条件下通过象征性的替代办法加以检验。 因此,我们向两种媒体提出相同的任务,提供相同的投入,输出规格和评价者:一个编码代理撰写的程序不是去名化像素,而是让解答视频成名,一个没有修改的规则评价者得分. 在VBVR-Pro-Bench(Xu等,2026年)上,代理商获得与视频模型相同的第一帧和即时,无法访问地面真理,元数据或生成模型,每例一次尝试. 3个闭合型特效(Codex有gpt-6-astra,克洛德代码有Fable 5.1和双子座CLI有双子座3.1 Pro)得分为0.923分,0.894分和0.893分,每分都超过最强的视频模型上方的0.22分. 在23个可运行的可开放量级模型中,最优秀的GLM-5达到0.572,更是除RL训练的外所有视频模型. 我们共同表明,对于从第一个框架和即时计算出解决方案的任务来说,程序合成目前是比视频生成更可靠的视觉推理途径。 我们进一步区分了描绘性程序,它导航图像以恢复可转移方案,它与命题程序,它们以硬码值运行,揭示透视推理如何在代理写作程序中展开,以及它对于一般推理的性质意味着什么.

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Coding agents as visual reasoners. Given the same first frame and prompt, a video generation model denoises the answer video directly, whereas a coding agent writes and executes a program that renders it. Both outputs share one video format and are scored by the same unmodified official evaluator, which compares them against symbolic ground truth using classical computer vision. The coding agent outperforms the best video model overall. The two solutions to one sequence task illustrate how the agents differ: Claude Code navigates the image to recover a transferable scheme (depictive), whereas Codex resolves the specific visual problem by hard-coding the answer it identified for that instance (propositional).
blocks.zh: 图1 编码代理作为视觉理性. 鉴于相同的第一个帧和即时,一个视频生成模型会直接将解答视频弄出,而一个编码代理则会写出并执行一个制作它的程序. 这两种产出都采用一种视频格式,由同一未经修改的官方评价人员评分,该评价人员利用经典计算机视觉将其与象征性地面真相相提并论。 编码代理总体优于最佳视频模型. 一种顺序任务的两种解决办法说明了不同物剂的差异: Claude Code导航图像以回收可转移方案(depictive),而Codex则通过硬编码它为这个例子确定的答案(Propositional)来解决具体的视觉问题.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Video generation models now render photorealistic, temporally coherent footage across a wide range of domains ( OpenAI, 2024 ; Google DeepMind, 2025 ; Team Wan et al., 2025 ; Kuaishou Technology, 2026 ; Kong et al., 2024 ) , prompting a growing line of inquiry into whether they can function as visual reasoners: producing videos that constitute solutions to structured tasks rather than renderings of descriptions ( Wiedemer et al., 2025 ; Tong et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Newman et al., 2026 ; Luo et al., 2025 ; He et al., 2025 ; Qi et al., 2026 ) . VBVR-Pro ( Xu et al., 2026 ) provides a verifiable, large-scale standard for this question, pairing procedurally generated tasks with rule-based evaluation against symbolic ground truth. Each instance presents a first frame and a natural-language prompt, and the model must produce the video that carries out the prompt. VBVR-Pro-Bench comprises 100 task families with five instances each, and the evaluator scores the output frames across five cognitive categories: abstraction , perception , spatiality , transformation and knowledge . Current video models remain substantially below the ceiling of this benchmark, including the strongest entry, a model RL-trained on the benchmark’s task families with the evaluator as verifiable reward.
blocks.zh: 视频生成模型现在将摄影现实化、时间上一致的镜头跨出广泛的领域(OpenAI,2024;Google DeepMind,2025;Team Wan等,2025;Kuaishou Technology,2026;Kong等,2024;Kong等,2024),促使人们越来越深入地调查这些视频是否能够起到视觉理性的作用:制作视频,构成结构化任务的解决办法,而不是描述(Wiedemer等,2025;Tong等,2026;Yang等,2025a;Wang等,2026b;Newman等,2026;Luo等,2025;He等,2025;Qi等,2026)。 VBVR-Pro(Xu等,2026年)为这个问题提供了一个可核查的,大规模的标准,将程序生成的任务与基于规则的评价与象征性的地基真理相配合. 每个实例呈现出第一帧和自然语言的快取,而模型必须制作进行快取的视频. VBVR-Pro-Bench由100个任务家族组成,每个家族有5个实例,评价者对产出框架进行分数,分为五个认知类别:抽象、感知、空间、转化和知识。 目前的视频模型仍然大大低于这一基准的上限,包括最强的输入,一个以评价者为可核查奖励的基准任务家族的RL模型。

blocks.en: We address the same benchmark under a controlled change of medium, motivated by the observation that, for most VBVR-Pro tasks, the correct output is a deterministic function of the first frame and the prompt. A model that denoises pixels must recover this function implicitly within the generative process, whereas a model that writes code can state it explicitly and delegate rendering to an interpreter. We therefore replace the medium of the answer and hold every other element of the evaluation fixed. A coding agent receives the same first frame and prompt, together with the required container specification (frame size, frame rate, frame count and duration), and writes a program that renders the answer video. It has no access to the ground truth, the task generator or the task metadata, may not invoke an image or video generation model, runs in a CPU sandbox with standard Python imaging libraries under a 30-minute wall-clock budget, and has one attempt per instance. The output is scored by the unmodified official evaluator, and an instance without a delivered video scores zero, as it would for a video model that fails to generate ( Figure 1 ). This instantiates the program-synthesis route to visual reasoning ( Gao et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2023 ; Surís et al., 2023 ; Gupta and Kembhavi, 2023 ) on a benchmark designed for video models and assessed on their terms; related work is reviewed in Appendix A . We apply the protocol to all 500 instances with three closed-model coding agents (Codex with gpt-6-astra, Claude Code with Fable 5.1 and Gemini CLI with Gemini 3.1 Pro) and, through the OpenCode harness, 23 runnable open-weight models (DeepSeek R1 is excluded as it does not support tool invocation on Amazon Bedrock). Video-model scores are taken from the published VBVR-Pro leaderboard and were not rerun.
blocks.zh: 我们在有控制的介质变化下处理同样的基准,其动机是,对于大多数VBVR-Pro任务来说,正确的输出是第一个帧和即时的决定性函数. 一个去除像素的模型必须在基因过程内隐含地恢复这个功能,而写出代码的模型则可以明确表示它,并将渲染委托给一个解释者. 因此,我们更换答案的媒介,并固定评价的所有其他内容。 编码代理接收相同的第一个帧并迅速,连同所需的容器规格(帧大小,帧速率,帧计数和持续时间),并写出一个制作解答视频的程序. 它无法访问地面真理,任务生成器或任务元数据,不能引用图像或视频生成模型,在30分钟的墙上小时预算下运行于有标准Python成像库的CPU沙盒中,并且每个实例都有一次尝试. 产出由未经修改的官方评价人员评分,没有交付视频的事例得分为零,因为无法生成视频模型(图1)。 本文将程序-合成路径描述为视觉推理(Gao等,2023;Chen等,2023;Surís等,2023;Gupta和Kembhavi,2023;),以为视频模型设计的基准并按其条件评估;相关工作在附录A中审查. 我们把协议应用于所有500个有3个闭合型编码代理(有gpt-6-astra的Codex,有Fable 5.1的Claude Code和有双子座3.1 Pro的双子座CLI),并通过"OpenCode"(OpenCode)使用23个可运行的可开量模型(DeepSeek R1被排除在外,因为它不支持在亚马逊贝德洛克上引用工具). 视频模型分数取自已公布的VBVR-Pro领跑板,没有被重播.

blocks.en: Coding agents score substantially above video models. The three closed-model agents reach 0.923, 0.894 and 0.893 and lead in every task category, while the strongest video model, trained with reinforcement learning on the benchmark’s task families with the evaluator as verifiable reward, reaches 0.670. The best open-weight model, GLM-5, scores 0.572, above every video model except the RL-trained one. Among open-weight models, low scores are driven mainly by delivery failure: models that never invoke a tool, stop before executing their code, or exhaust the time budget deliver few videos. Beyond the minimum tool use needed to deliver a video, the amount of tool use does not predict score, and the three closed agents, whose scores span a range of 0.030, differ by nearly an order of magnitude in cost. Finally, the agents’ programs divide into two modes: depictive programs are general programs written by the agents that could solve any particularly instances of the task kind, whereas propositional programs encode an answer derived in the agent’s session as symbolic constants and only render it, and by that such program written by the agent does not transfer the solving ability to another instance of the task kind. The depictive share is highest on perception and transformation tasks and the propositional share on abstraction and knowledge tasks, and neither mode predicts performance.
blocks.zh: 编码代理得分大大高于视频模型. 3个封闭型代理商达到0.923、0.894和0.893,在每一个任务类别中都领先,而最强的视频模型则在基准任务领域接受强化学习培训,评价员作为可核实的奖励,达到0.670。 最佳开放量级模型GLM-5,得分为0.572分,高于除RL训练出的一个外的每个视频模型. 在开放量级模型中,低分主要是由交付失败所驱动的:从不引用工具的模型,在执行代码之前就停止,或者用尽了预算提供少量视频的时间. 除了传送视频所需的最低工具使用量外,工具使用量并不预测得分,其得分范围为0.030的3个被关闭的代理商在成本上几乎相去甚远. 最后,代理程序分为两种模式: 描述程序是由代理人员编写的普通程序,可以解决任何特定的任务类型的事件,而命题程序将代理人员会话中得出的一个答案编码为符号常数并只使其成形,而代理人员编写的这种程序不会将解析能力转移给任务类型的另一个实例。 描写分量最高的是感知和转化任务,和抽象和知识任务的命题分量,两个模式都不预测性能.

blocks.en: Together, we provide: (1) a controlled comparison in which coding agents answer VBVR-Pro tasks by writing a program that renders the answer video, under the same inputs, output container and official evaluator as the video models, covering three closed-model agents and 23 open-weight models against published video-model results on all 500 instances, with category-level scores; (2) an efficiency analysis , which separates delivery failure from content failure while accounting for tool calls, runtime and tokens; and (3) an analysis of the reasoning strategies behind the agents’ programs, in which we classify the 1,385 programs with which the closed agents solve their own instance as depictive , if they navigate the image at runtime to recover a general scheme that transfers to a different instance of the same task family, or as propositional , if they operate on hard-coded values and are therefore confined to the single instance for which they were written, and find that the balance of the two strategies varies with the task category. These results collectively show that, for tasks whose solutions can be computed from a first frame and a prompt, explicit program synthesis currently outperforms native video generation by a substantial margin, and that the strategies by which agents reach this performance offer insight into how visual reasoning could be approached in world modelling, whether natively or through code.
blocks.zh: 我们共同提供:(1) 对照所有500个案例的已公布的视频模型结果,用分类分数,对编码员回答VBVR-Pro任务进行对照对照对照;(2) 效率分析,将发送失败与内容失败区分开来,同时计及工具调用、运行时间和符号;(3) 分析代理程序背后的推理策略,将1,385个程序分类为描述性程序,如果这些被关闭的代理在运行时浏览图像,以恢复一个将传输到同一任务家族不同情况的一般方案,或作为命题,如果它们以硬编码值操作,并因此限制在编成的单一例子中,则将这两种战略的平衡与任务类别不同。 这些结果集体表明,对于其解决方案可以从第一个框架和迅速、明确的程序合成中计算出来的任务,目前远远超出本地视频生成,而代理商达到这种性能的战略使人们深入了解如何在本地或通过代码的世界建模中处理视觉推理。

blocks.en: 2 Method
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: This section describes the evaluation protocol: the agent and sandbox setup ( Section 2.1 ), the benchmark ( Section 2.2 ), scoring ( Section 2.3 ) and efficiency accounting ( Section 2.4 ). A coding agent receives the same first-frame and prompt inputs as a video model, writes a program that renders the answer video, and is scored by the benchmark’s official evaluator. All results in this paper are produced by a single end-to-end pipeline that implements this protocol ( Section 2.3 ).
blocks.zh: 本节介绍评价协议:代理和沙盒设置(第2.1节)、基准(第2.2节)、评分(第2.3节)和效率核算(第2.4节)。 编码代理接受与视频模型相同的第一帧和即时输入,写出一个制作答案视频的程序,并由基准的官方评价者打分. 本文件中的所有结果均由执行该议定书的单一端到端管道产生(第2.3节)。

blocks.en: 2.1 Coding Agents as Visual Reasoners
blocks.zh: 2.1 编码代理作为视觉理性器

blocks.en: Task statement. Each instance runs in a fresh container holding only its inputs together with a task statement generated by the harness. The statement is identical in structure for every agent and instance; only the instance-specific output format varies. It instructs the agent to write a program that renders the answer video and imposes three constraints: no image or video generation model may be called, only what the prompt requires may change, and the action must unfold over the full clip.
blocks.zh: 任务说明. 每个实例都在一个新鲜的容器中运行,只保存其投入以及由吊带产生的任务说明。 语句在结构上与每个代理和实例相同;只有针对实例的输出格式不同. 它指示代理者写出一个制作解答视频并施加三个限制的程序:任何图像或视频生成模型都不得被调用,只有提示需要的才能改变,动作必须在完整剪辑上展开.

blocks.en: Sandbox. The container is a CPU-only Python environment, standard imaging and scientific libraries, and a set of fonts preinstalled. The agent runs as an unprivileged user under fixed resource limits and a 30-minute wall-clock budget, with network access enabled for model API calls and package installation. The rules forbid generative image and video models, confirmed by an audit of every event log and retained program. Each instance receives exactly one attempt with no retry; an instance without a video at exit scores zero.
blocks.zh: 沙发盒. 容器是一个只使用CPU的Python环境,标准成像和科学库,以及一套被预先安装的字体. 代理在固定资源限度下作为无特权用户运行,并有30分钟的墙上时速预算,网络访问可以进行模型API呼叫和包安装. 这些规则禁止基因图象和视频模型,并通过对每个事件日志和保留程序的审计予以确认。 每个实例都收到一次完全没有重试的尝试;一个没有视频的实例在退出时得分为零.

blocks.en: Agents. Each agent is an off-the-shelf command-line coding tool that drives a language model: it reads files, runs commands, edits code and iterates until it decides the task is complete. We run each tool in its official non-interactive mode with approvals bypassed and default settings, adding no system prompt, skill or other modification. Table 1 below lists the three closed-model agents along with the versions and models used respectively.
blocks.zh: 探员 每个代理是一个现成的命令行编码工具,可以驱动一个语言模型:它读取文件,运行命令,编辑代码并延后到它决定任务完成. 我们以正式的非交互模式运行每个工具,其批准被绕过和默认设置,不添加系统即时,技能或其他修改. 下文表1列出了三种封闭型代理以及分别使用的版本和型号.

blocks.en: 2.2 The Benchmark
blocks.zh: 2.2 国家 基准

blocks.en: The basic setup follows VBVR-Pro-Bench ( Xu et al., 2026 ) . The input consists of a 1024×1024 image and a task prompt. The evaluation kit gives each family one or more of five category labels: Perception 39 families, Abstraction 25, Knowledge 20, Transformation 19, and Spatiality 17, inherited from the original work. Sixteen families have more than one label. If a family has k labels, it counts as 1/k toward each of its categories, and a category’s score is just the weighted average over the instances from those families.
blocks.zh: 基本设置沿用了VBVR-Pro-Bench(徐等,2026. 输入包含一个1024×1024图像和一个任务提示. 评估包给每个家庭一个或一个以上的五个类别标签:感知39个家庭、抽象25个家庭、知识20个家庭、转型19个家庭以及从原始作品中继承的空间17个家庭。 16个家庭有多个标签. 如果一个家庭有k的标签,它按每个类别计算为1/k,一个类别的得分仅仅是这些家庭的加权平均数。

blocks.en: Table 1: The three closed-model coding agents, each the vendor’s own CLI run in non-interactive mode with approvals bypassed.
blocks.zh: 表1:三个封闭型编码代理商,每个供应商自己的CLI以非互动方式运行,并绕过批准.

blocks.en: Open-weight models. To test whether the findings are contingent to frontier closed models, we apply the same protocol with OpenCode ( OpenCode contributors, 2026 ) , an open-source coding agent that drives any model through a standard chat API. We evaluate 24 open-weight models served by Amazon Bedrock from the GLM, Kimi, MiniMax, DeepSeek, Qwen, gpt-oss, Nemotron, Mistral, Llama and Gemma families, each under the same task statement, sandbox and time limit as the closed agents. One model, DeepSeek R1, cannot call tools on Bedrock and is marked as unsupported, leaving 23 scored models.
blocks.zh: 开放量级模型. 为了测试发现是否属于边疆封闭模型,我们与OpenCode(OpenCode 撰稿人,2026年)应用了同样的协议,这是一个开源编码代理,通过标准的聊天API驱动任何模型. 我们从GLM、Kimi、MiniMax、DeepSeek、Quen、gpt-oss、Nemotron、Mistral、Llama和Gemma三个家庭, 一个模型DeepSeek R1不能在Bedrock上调用工具,被标记为不支持,留下了23个得分的模型.

blocks.en: 2.3 Scoring
blocks.zh: 2.3 分数

blocks.en: Every video is scored by the official VBVR-Pro-Bench evaluation kit, unmodified, in the mode used for the published leaderboard. Each task family’s rule-based evaluator compares the video with the symbolic ground truth using classical computer vision and OCR and returns a score in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] . An instance without a video scores 0, as it does for a video model that fails to generate. A system’s score is the mean over all 500 instances; category scores follow the weighting defined in Section 2.2 . Video-model scores are those published with VBVR-Pro ( Xu et al., 2026 ) , computed with the same kit; we do not rerun those models.
blocks.zh: 每段视频都由官方的VBVR-Pro-Bench评价套件打分,未经修改,采用已发布的领导板所使用的模式. 每个任务家庭的基于规则的评价者利用古典计算机视觉和OCR将视频与象征地真相相提并论,并返回 [0, 1] [0, 1] 的分数. 一个没有视频的例子得分为0,就像它对于一个无法生成的视频模型一样. 系统得分是所有500例的平均值;类别得分沿用第2.2节所定义的权重。 VBVR-Pro(Xu等,2026年)用同一套工具计算,

blocks.en: 2.4 Efficiency Measures
blocks.zh: 2.4 增效措施

blocks.en: Each agent CLI writes a machine-readable log of its run, retained for every instance. From these logs we derive three quantities: tool calls (actions the agent takes), tokens (model input and output as reported by the agent) and wall-clock time (elapsed time from container start to exit, including model latency). We report tool calls and tokens as means over 500 instances and wall-clock time as the median. We also record whether the agent called any tool, whether it reached the time limit, and whether a failed instance involved tool use; these flags support the failure analysis in Section 3.3 . Token counts are comparable within an agent and only indicative across agents, since tokenisers and caching differ.
blocks.zh: 每个代理CLI都会写一个机器可读的运行日志, 从这些日志中我们得出了三个数量:工具调用(代理机的动作),符号(代理机报告的模型输入和输出)和相接时钟时间(从容器开始到出站的时间被缩短,包括模型空档). 我们报告各种工具的呼叫和信使,作为500多个实例和中位数的墙上时间。 我们还记录了代理机是否调用任何工具,它是否达到时限,以及失败实例是否涉及工具的使用;这些旗帜支持第3.3节中的失败分析. 托肯计数在代理人内部是可比较的,并且只是跨代理人之间的指示,因为象征性的和缓存不同.

blocks.en: 3 Results
blocks.zh: 3 结果

blocks.en: 3.1 Main Results
blocks.zh: 3.1 主要成果

blocks.en: 3.4 Distinct Strategies of Agentic Code-driven Visual Reasoning: Depictive and propositional programs
blocks.zh: 3.4 代理代码驱动的视觉理性的不同战略:偏差和命题程序

blocks.en: A coding agent’s score does not reveal how its program arrives at the answer. We classified the 1,385 solve programs with which the three closed agents solve their own instance, and identified two reasoning strategies, distinguished by whether the program obtains the answer from the image or operates on values fixed in advance. A depictive program navigates the pixel array of the first frame—filtering colours, measuring regions, locating objects—as one navigates a stored visual representation, and derives its answer from what it finds there. Its procedure is therefore tied to the task family rather than to the instance, and transfers to any instance of the same family. A propositional program operates on hard-coded values—coordinates, colour values, cell indices—that the agent established beforehand and that the program only renders. It externalises the conclusion rather than the procedure that produced it, and is confined to the instance for which it was written: run on a different instance, it would render the same, now incorrect, answer. We assign the strategy behaviourally, by re-executing each program on a different instance of the same task family ( Figure 3 ) among the four alternatives provided in VBVR-Pro-Bench ( Xu et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 编码代理商的分数并不能显示其程序是如何到达答案的。 我们把三个被关闭的代理解决自己实例的1,385个解析程序分类,并确定了两个推理策略,区别在于程序是从图像中获得答案,还是在预先确定的值上运行. 一个描绘性的程序导航第一个帧的像素阵列——过滤颜色,测量区域,定位物体——一个浏览存储的可视化表现,并从它在那里发现的东西中得出答案. 因此,其程序与任务家庭而不是案件有关,并且转移给同一家庭的任何案件。 一个命题程序运行在硬编码的值上——坐标,颜色值,单元格指数——这是代理商事先建立的,程序只能制作. 它将结论外部化,而不是产生结论的程序,并局限于它所写的例子:在不同的场合运行,它将使现在不正确的同样答案。 在VBVR-Pro-Bench(徐等,2026年)提供的四种选择中,我们以行为方式分配战略,在同一个任务家族的不同实例上重新实施每个方案(图3)。

blocks.en: We name the two modes after the representational distinction at the centre of the mental imagery debate ( Kosslyn, 1980 ; Pylyshyn, 1981 ) . A depictive representation preserves the spatial structure of what it represents and supports reasoning by inspection—by depicting the properties from a stored array-like structure, as in early computational models of imagery ( Kosslyn and Shwartz, 1977 ) —whereas a propositional representation encodes information as discrete symbolic assertions in an amodal medium ( Fodor, 1975 ) , accessed by retrieval rather than spatial inspection. Depictive programs stand in the same relation to the first frame as hypothesised depictive imagery stands to a remembered scene: the first-frame is maintained as a spatial array, and the program reasons by navigating it. Propositional programs, conversely, encode the answer in a form that is indifferent to the spatial structure of the frame, stating what to render without re-examining the image. Depictive programs are themselves not analogue of the scene in any strict sense: they consist of symbolic code that navigates the arrays representing the image. Whether these programs’ strategies correspond to processes in human visual cognition remains open, subjected to resolutions of the mental imagery debate, but we believe this diagnosis offers a helpful comparison for understanding how visual reasoning happens in agentic coding.
blocks.zh: 我们以心理影像辩论中心的代表性区别(Kosslyn,1980年;Pylyshyn,1981年)命名两种模式。 描绘性表述保留了它所代表的空间结构,并通过检查——通过描述储存的类似阵列结构的属性,例如图像的早期计算模型(Kosslyn和Shwartz,1977年)——来支持推理,其中一种命题表述将信息编码为一种模式媒介(Fodor,1975年)中的离散的象征性断言,通过检索而不是空间检查获得。 偏差程序与第一帧的相对关系与假想的描绘图像与被记住的场景的相对关系相同:第一帧作为空间阵列保持,通过导航程序的原因. 反之,建议程序将答案编码为对框架的空间结构漠不关心的形式,说明在不重新审视图像的情况下要渲染什么. 偏差程序本身并不是任何严格意义上的场景的模拟:它们由象征式代码组成来导航代表图像的阵列. 这些计划策略是否与人类视觉认知过程相适应, 是否仍然开放,

blocks.en: The balance of the two modes depends on the task category ( Figure 3 ). Depictive programs account for 67% of Perception and 45% of Transformation programs—tasks that require locating, measuring and moving objects the code can find in the pixels. The share falls to 33% for Abstraction and 27% for Knowledge , where the propositional share is highest (26% and 28%, against 6% for Transformation ); these tasks require recognising a rule or applying stored knowledge, and the agent more often settles the answer in the session. Spatiality lies between the two, combining scene reading with path and relation computation ( Section D.3 ). Among the closed agents, Claude Code keeps the measurement in the program more often (61% depictive) than Codex (35%). Gemini CLI opens the frame on only 10 of 500 instances (2.0%), yet 17% of its programs are propositional, the constants having been obtained by exploratory scripts during the session ( Section D.1 ). Neither mode signals performance: Codex has the highest score of the three despite only 24% of its Abstraction programs being depictive. The category alignment suggests that mode tracks the nature of the required reasoning: tasks that demand spatial operations on the frame favour depictive programs, whereas those that require rule inference or knowledge retrieval more often yield propositional ones.
blocks.zh: 两种模式的平衡取决于任务类别(图3). 怀疑程序占到感知程序的67%,占变形程序的45%——这些任务需要查找、测量和移动代码可以在像素中找到的物体。 这些任务需要识别规则或应用存储的知识, 代理商更常在会话中解答。 空间位于两者之间,将场景读取与路径和关系计算相结合(D.3节)。 在闭合剂中,克洛德码在程序中保持了更频繁的测量(61%可描绘),而克洛德码(35%). 双子座CLI在500例中只打开了10例(2.0%)的框架,然而其17%的程序是命题,这些常数是在会议期间通过探索脚本获得的(D.1节)。 两种模式的信号性能都没有: Codex虽然其抽象化程序只有24%具有描写性,但拥有这三种中最高分. 类别对接建议模式跟踪所需推理的性质:需要帧上空间操作的任务偏好描写程序,而需要规则推论或知识检索的任务更经常产生命题.

blocks.en: Figure 4 illustrates this separation on one instance of G-131, an increasing-size sequence task. The first frame shows three orange circles of increasing size in the first three positions of a row, an empty fourth position and four candidate answers. Claude Code and Codex select the same, correct candidate and obtain the same score, but their programs differ. Claude Code’s program carries the whole procedure: it extracts the coloured regions, measures the circle widths (21, 39 and 57 pixels), computes their constant difference (18 pixels), predicts the next width (75 pixels) and tests each candidate against the recovered constraints on colour, shape and size. It is depictive and would recompute the answer on a different instance. Codex settles the answer during its session, and its program contains only fixed pixel coordinates and drawing operations that reproduce the explanation and highlight the chosen option. It is propositional and would highlight the same position on a different instance. Identical outputs on the instance at hand thus conceal programs of different generality, which is why score alone cannot identify the mode. Two further examples are given in Section D.4 .
blocks.zh: 图4用G-131的一例说明这种分离,这是一个规模越来越大的序列任务。 第一帧显示出三个橙色圆圈在一行前三个位置上体积越来越大,空出第四个位置和四个候选答案. Claude Code和Codex选择相同,正确的候选人并获得相同的分数,但他们的程序不同. Claude Code的程序承载了整个程序:它提取出有色区域,测量出圆相宽度(21,39和57像素),计算出它们的恒定相差(18像素),预测出下个宽度(75像素),并对照恢复的颜色,形状和大小的限制测试每个候选者. 它具有描写性,并将在不同的事例中重新计算答案。 Codex在会话中结算答案,其程序只包含固定的像素坐标和绘图操作来复制解释并突出所选选项. 这是主张性的,将突出不同情况下的同样立场。 因此,当前实例上的相同产出掩盖了不同笼统的程序,这就是为什么单凭得分无法确定模式的原因。 D.4节列举了另外两个例子。

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Depictive and propositional programs on the same instance of G-131. (a) The input frame shared by both agents. (b) Claude Code (depictive): the program measures the circle widths, computes the constant difference and evaluates the candidates at run time. (c) Codex (propositional): the correct candidate is identified in the session, and the program only renders and highlights it. Both agents select the same candidate and obtain the same score.
blocks.zh: 图4:关于G-131同一案例的推理和命题方案。 (a) 两个代理人共用的输入框架。 (b) Claude Code (depictive):程序测量圆宽度,计算常数差并评价在跑时间的候选人. (c) Codex(提议):在会话中确定正确的候选人,程序只制作并突出其内容. 两位代理都选择了相同的候选人并获得相同的分数.

blocks.en: 4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: We evaluated coding agents on VBVR-Pro-Bench by having an agent write a program that renders the answer video from the same first frame and prompt that a video model receives, leaving the output format and the official evaluator unchanged. Under this protocol, all three closed-model agents clearly outperform the strongest video model, which was trained on the benchmark’s own task families with the evaluator as reward, and the best open-weight agent also exceeds every other video model ( Sections 3.1 and 3.3 ). The agents’ programs further reveal that the reasoning does not always take place in the program itself: in some cases the program recovers the answer from the frame when it runs (depictive programs), and in others the agent resolves the answer during its session and the program only renders it (propositional programs).
blocks.zh: 我们评价了VBVR-Pro-Bench上的编码代理商,方法是让代理商写出一个程序,让同一第一帧的解答视频,并提示视频模型收到,使输出格式和官方评价者保持不变. 根据这项协议,所有三名封闭型代理商都明显超越了最强的视频模型,该模型接受了关于基准自身任务家族的培训,评价员作为奖励,最佳的开放式代理商也超过了所有其他视频模型(第3.1和3.3节)。 代理程序进一步揭示,推理并不总是发生在程序本身:在某些情况下,程序运行时会从帧中恢复答案(显性程序),而在另一些情况下,代理程序会在其会话中解答答案,而程序只能使答案出(提议程序).

blocks.en: Taken together, the results indicate that coding agents currently solve the tasks of a benchmark built for video models more reliably than the video models themselves. This describes the present state of video reasoning and does not establish a limit in principle on what generative video models can learn. However, as an exploratory interpretation, it could suggest that native visual reasoning may be better suited to problems that depend less on symbolic, language-like operations. In humans, mental rotation, mechanical reasoning and intuitive physics are commonly attributed to visual-spatial simulation ( Shepard and Metzler, 1971 ; Hegarty, 2004 ; Battaglia et al., 2013 ) , whereas inferring a rule or applying stored knowledge is more naturally described in the discrete, compositional terms of language-of-thought accounts ( Fodor, 1975 ; Quilty-Dunn et al., 2023 ) ; how far mental imagery is itself depictive rather than propositional remains debated ( Kosslyn, 1980 ; Pylyshyn, 1981 ) . The division of reasoning modes by task category shows a similar correspondence in coding agents ( Section 3.4 ): tasks that call for locating, measuring and moving objects in the frame have the highest share of depictive programs, whereas tasks that require recognising a rule or applying stored knowledge have the highest share of propositional ones—the agent accesses the frame’s information in the session rather than at run time and encodes the conclusion as symbolic constants in the program, separating inference from rendering. An interpretation of this is that coding agents, with their language backbone, may have inherent mechanistic properties that correspond to how humans navigate array-based mental imagery for reasoning, without instantiating the strongest depictive claim—that reasoning is itself embodied in the transformation of an analogue representation per se, one that is most intuitive for the conscious, flexible manipulation of mental imagery observed in humans. If so, while natural language supports reasoning in language models ( Rothschild, 2025 ) , most visibly through chain-of-thought ( Wei et al., 2022 ) , the combination of code and visual information may serve as a less linguistically-demanding medium that navigates structured visual representations through symbolic operations, serving a similar function for visually grounded agents ( Yang et al., 2025b ) , so that “native visual reasoning” is not the exclusive province of systems that purely manipulate visual information (like video models), in accordance with some interpretations of human visual reasoning.
blocks.zh: 综合来看,结果表明编码代理目前比视频模型本身更可靠地解决为视频模型所构建的基准任务. 这描述了视频推理的目前状态,并没有在原则上对基因视频模型可以学习什么设定限制. 然而,作为一种探索性的解释,它可能表明,本土视觉推理可能更适合那些较少依赖象征性的,语言类操作的问题. 在人类中,精神自转,机械推理和直觉物理通常被归结为视觉-空间模拟(Shepard and Metzler, 1971;Hegarty, 2004;Battaglia等, 2013;Battaglia et al.),而引出一条规则或应用所储存的知识则在思想语言的分立的,组成术语中更自然地被描述(Fodor, 1975;Quilty-Dunn等, 2023;心灵影像本身的描写性,而不是命题的活体被争论到底有多远(Koslyn, 1980;Pylyshyn, 1981.). 按任务类别划分的推理模式在编码符(第3.4节)中显示了相类似的对应关系:要求查找,测量和移动帧中对象的任务在描述程序中所占的份额最高,而要求识别规则或应用存储的知识的任务在命题中所占的份额最高 -- -- 代理在会话中而不是在运行时访问帧的信息并将结论编码为程序中的象征性常数,将推论与渲染区分开来. 对这一点的解释是,编码剂及其语言主干可能具有与人类如何导航基于数组的心理图像进行推理相适应的内在机械特性,而无需即时地提出最强的描述性主张——推理本身就体现在模拟表现本身的转变中,而这种转变对于在人类中观察到的有意识地、灵活地操纵心理图像来说是最直观的。 如果是的话,自然语言支持语言模型中的推理(Rothschild,2025年),最明显的是通过思维链(Wei等,2022年),而代码和视觉信息的组合可能作为一个语言需求较少的介质,通过符号操作来导航结构化的视觉表现,为视觉受限的代理(Yang等,2025年b)提供类似功能,因此按照对人类视觉推理的一些解释,"本土视觉推理"并非纯粹操纵视觉信息的系统(类似视频模型)的专属范畴.

blocks.en: Several features of the benchmark and the comparison limit how far these findings generalise. Although VBVR-Pro-Bench was designed for video models, its tasks are generated and rendered by code, with flat colours, exact geometry and deterministic evaluators, a setting in which programmatic solutions are especially natural. The agents can decompose such scenes into colour masks, connected components and grid cells, in effect recovering the symbolic description from which the frame was rendered, and then produce the answer by editing pixels. This may not transfer to real-world scenarios in which objects are textured, occluded and variably lit, no symbolic ground truth exists, and an answer cannot be produced by editing a few regions of the first frame without a generative model. The comparison is also asymmetric: the agents use tools, a sandbox and up to 30 minutes of iteration, whereas the video models produce a single sample, and agent cost varies by more than an order of magnitude across models.
blocks.zh: 基准和比较的若干特征限制了这些结论的概括程度。 虽然VBVR-Pro-Bench是为视频模型而设计的,但其任务由代码产生和提供,有平平的颜色,精确的几何和确定性的评价师,一个方案解决方案特别自然的设置. 代理器可以将这样的场景分解成彩色口罩,相接组件和网格单元格,实际上可以恢复提供帧的符号描述,然后通过编辑像素生成答案. 这可能不会转移到现实世界的情景中,在现实世界中,物体被纹理所穿透,被被吞噬并被反复点燃,不存在象征性的地基真理,没有基因模型,无法通过编辑第一个框架的几个区域来产生答案. 比较也是不对称的:物剂使用工具,一个沙盒并长达30分钟的迭代,而视频模型则产生单一的样本,而物剂成本在跨模型的大小顺序上有所不同.

blocks.en: These limitations point to several directions for future work. Because the evaluator is deterministic, it can also serve as a reward, making a natural next step the training of the code-writing policy with GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) , mirroring the reinforcement learning that VBVR-Pro applied to video models ( Xu et al., 2026 ) . The protocol could also be extended from a single first frame to video-to-video settings in three dimensions, such as WROP ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) , in which a model must continue a Blender-rendered clip while preserving object permanence and solidity; this would test whether the agents’ advantage persists when the scene must be inferred from a clip rather than a single frame, although WROP is currently judged mainly by human preference, so a verifiable scorer would be needed. Beyond these, it remains open whether the advantage holds on real-world footage and whether hybrid systems that pair a coding agent with a generative renderer can combine the strengths of both.
blocks.zh: 这些局限性为今后的工作指明了几个方向。 由于评价者是决定性的,因此也可以作为奖励,使下一步自然成为与GRPO(Shao等,2024年)的代码编写政策培训,反映了VBVR-Pro应用于视频模型的强化学习(Xu等,2026年). 协议还可以从一个单一的第一帧扩展至视频到视频的三维设置,如WROP(张等,2026年),其中一个模型在保留物体的持久性和固态性的同时,必须继续使用Blender-rested剪辑;这将检验当必须从剪辑而非单一帧推断出场景时,代理商的优势是否继续存在,尽管目前WROP主要根据人类的偏好来判断,所以需要一个可核实的分数器. 除此之外,是否在现实世界的镜头上占有优势,以及将编码剂与基因渲染器配对的混合系统能否将两者的优势结合起来,仍然持开放态度.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We evaluated coding agents on VBVR-Pro-Bench by having them write programs that render the answer video, with the benchmark’s inputs, output format and official evaluator unchanged. Three closed-model agents score 0.893 to 0.923, against 0.670 for the strongest video model, which was trained with reinforcement learning on the benchmark’s task families, and the best open-weight agent (0.572) exceeds every other video model. The agents’ programs follow two strategies: depictive programs navigate the image to recover a general scheme that transfers to other instances of the same task family, whereas propositional programs operate on hard-coded values and are confined to the instance for which they were written. The depictive share is highest on tasks that require locating, measuring and moving objects found in the pixels, whereas the propositional share is highest on tasks that require recognising a rule or applying stored knowledge, where the agent more often derives the answer itself and encodes it in the program. Overall, these results show that explicit program synthesis currently outperforms native video generation by a substantial margin, and that, depending on the task, visual reasoning need not rely on systems that manipulate visual information alone: code operating on visual input can not only serve as a medium for abstract inference based on stored values, but may also support imagery-like reasoning by navigating the images descriptively when needed, implying an alternative approach to ”native visual reasoning” based on a debate shared across human and machines.
blocks.zh: 我们评估了VBVR-Pro-Bench上的编码代理商,让他们写出让答案视频的程式,而基准输入、输出格式和官方评价者不变。 3名闭塞型代理商得分为0.893分到0.923分,而最强的视频模型则得分为0.670分,后者接受了关于基准任务家族的强化学习培训,最佳开放型代理商(0.572分)超过了所有其他视频模型. 代理程序遵循两种策略:描绘性程序引导图像,以恢复一个向同一任务家庭其他情况转移的一般方案,而命题程序则以硬码值运行,并局限于被写入的例子。 描绘性分享对于需要定位,测量和移动像素中发现的物体的任务是最高的,而命题分享对于需要识别规则或应用被存储的知识的任务是最高的,其中代理者更经常地从中获取答案,并在程序中编码. 总的来说,这些结果表明,目前明确的程序合成在相当程度上超越了原生视频生成,视从任务上看,视觉推理不需要依赖仅操控视觉信息的系统:在视觉输入上操作的代码不仅可以作为基于所存储值的抽象推断的媒介,还可以通过在需要时对图像进行描述来支持像图像的推理,意味着基于人与机器之间共有的争论的"内在视觉推理"的替代方法.

blocks.en: Appendix A Related Work
blocks.zh: 附录A 相关工作

blocks.en: A growing body of work investigates whether video generation models can themselves serve as reasoners. Wiedemer et al. (2025) document zero-shot “chain-of-frames” behaviour in Veo 3 across perception, manipulation and maze tasks, establishing that models can express visual reasoning as generated frame sequences. Tong et al. (2026) frame video generation as a general multimodal reasoning paradigm and benchmark it across diverse tasks. Subsequent work probes where in the model this reasoning lives: Wang et al. (2026b) identify a “chain-of-steps” mechanism in which conclusions form over the denoising trajectory, and Newman et al. (2026) show that the commitment to a solution happens within the first few denoising steps. Several concurrent benchmarks measure the capability at scale: VR-Bench ( Yang et al., 2025a ) evaluates spatial reasoning through maze-solving and finds that fine-tuned video models outperform vision-language models on procedural spatial tasks; V-ReasonBench ( Luo et al., 2025 ) , RULER-Bench ( He et al., 2025 ) and MME-CoF-Pro ( Qi et al., 2026 ) cover a wider range of dimensions and reach a more cautious conclusion: current models are promising on short-horizon spatial coherence but unreliable on long-horizon causal reasoning and abstract logic. VBVR ( Wang et al., 2026a ) and its successor VBVR-Pro ( Xu et al., 2026 ) scale the question further. Hundreds of procedural generators produce first-frame, prompt and answer-video triples; a rule-based evaluator scores each task family; and VBVR-Pro-Bench holds 50 families out of all training to separate in-distribution performance from generalisation. VBVR-Pro additionally post-trains video models using the same evaluators as verifiable rewards under GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ; DeepSeek-AI, 2025 ) adapted to flow and diffusion architectures ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Xue et al., 2025 ) ; its RL-trained checkpoints are the strongest video models on the benchmark. Most video generation benchmarks score with learned components. VBench ( Huang et al., 2024 ) mixes feature-based perceptual metrics; VideoScore ( He et al., 2024b ) trains a video-language judge; and LLM-as-a-judge protocols carry known positional and verbosity biases ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) . VBVR-Pro instead evaluates with classical computer vision against symbolic ground truth, so the same video always receives the same score and the score can serve directly as a reward signal. This property makes the comparison in our paper exact: a coding agent and a video model are graded by the same deterministic function on the same 500 instances.
blocks.zh: 越来越多的作品调查了视频生成模型本身能否起到理性的作用. Wiedemer等人(2025年)记录了Veo 3在感知,操纵和迷宫等任务中的零镜头"框架链"行为,确定模型能够以生成的框架序列来表达视觉推理. Tong等人(2026年)将视频生成作为通用的多模式推理范式,并将其作为不同任务的基准。 随后的工作探索了模型中这种推理所活之处: Wang等人(2026年b)确定了一个“步骤链”机制,其中结论形成于去诺音轨上,Newman等人(2026年)表明,对解决办法的承诺发生在最初几个去诺音步骤中。 几个并行基准衡量规模能力:VR-Bench(Yang等,2025a)通过迷宫解析评估空间推理,发现微调的视频模型优于程序空间任务的视觉语言模型;V-Reason Bench(Luo等,2025年),RULIR-Bench(He等,2025年)和MME-CoF-Pro(Qi等,2026年)涵盖更广阔的维度并得出更谨慎的结论:目前的模型在短视空间一致性方面很有希望,但在长视因果推理和抽象逻辑方面是不可靠的。 VBVR (Wang等, 2026a.) 及其后继的VBVR-Pro (Xu等, 2026.) 进一步标出这个问题. 数百台程序发电机生产出第一帧、即时和答录三重音;一个基于规则的评价员将每个任务家庭评分;VBVR-Pro-Bench将50个家庭置于所有培训之外,以区分分配业绩和一般化。 VBVR-Pro额外使用GRPO下可核查奖励的相同评价员的Troins后视频模型(Shao等,2024;DeepSeek-AI,2025)适应了流量与传播架构(Liu等,2026;Xue等,2025;其RL训练的检查站是基准上最强的视频模型. 大多数视频生成基准都以学习成份得分. V Bench(Huang等,2024年)混合了基于特征的感知度量衡;VideoScore(He等,2024年b)培训了一名视频语言法官;LLM-as-a-judge协议带有已知的位置和动词偏差(Zheng等,2023年). VBVR-Pro取而代之的是用古典计算机视觉对象征性地地面真理进行评价,因此同一视频总是得到相同的分数,分数可以直接作为奖励信号. 这个属性让我们的纸质精确的比较:一个编码代理和一个视频模型在同一500个实例上被同样的定型功能分级.

blocks.en: Writing a program has long been a route to visual understanding. Visual Programming ( Gupta and Kembhavi, 2023 ) and ViperGPT ( Surís et al., 2023 ) prompt a language model to compose vision-module calls into executable Python; Visual Sketchpad ( Hu et al., 2024 ) lets a multimodal model externalise intermediate results as drawn images. These systems produce text answers. On the language side, program-aided reasoning ( Gao et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2023 ) and Code as Policies ( Liang et al., 2023 ) showed that offloading computation to an interpreter improves reliability on arithmetic and embodied tasks. Off-the-shelf terminal coding agents—tools that iteratively read files, execute commands and revise programs in response to errors—are the current embodiment of this line of work. The evaluation pattern follows SWE-bench and SWE-agent ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024 ) : one sandboxed container per instance, one attempt, and a verifier decides. A recent cluster of work uses code to produce visual content, in most cases without a generative video model in the loop. Kubrick ( He et al., 2024a ) coordinates director, programmer and reviewer agents that write Blender scripts to render text-described videos, and outperforms seven text-to-video baselines on FVD, FID, CLIP similarity and in a user study. VIGA ( Yin et al., 2026 ) reconstructs reference images as executable 3D scenes through a render-and-inspect loop, supported by a purpose-built skill library and external asset generators, and simulates 4D physical dynamics through a physics engine. BVB ( Tang et al., 2026 ) targets video understanding: agents reconstruct real indoor videos as animated Blender scenes under a shared harness, scored by a VLM judge and a latent-similarity metric, and the best configuration retains only about half of the spatiotemporal facts in the source video despite high latent similarity. VideoCoCo ( Li et al., 2026 ) instead retains a video model: a coding agent writes a Blender program whose simulated draft conditions a generative video engine for photorealistic synthesis. Our setting differs from all four in three respects. First, the target is a verifiable reasoning benchmark in which a first frame and a prompt determine the answer, so correctness is decided by a deterministic evaluator rather than by distributional metrics, user studies or VLM judges. Second, the agents are off-the-shelf command-line tools used without modification, with no purpose-built skill library, asset retrieval or image or video generation model, and they render by writing pixels directly with standard imaging libraries rather than through a 3D engine. Third, the agents are scored on the same leaderboard as video models, including models trained on the benchmark itself, which permits a direct comparison of the two routes to the same task.
blocks.zh: 写一个程序长期以来一直是实现视觉理解的途径. Visual programming (Gupta and Kembhavi, 2023)和 ViperGPT (Surís等, 2023) 促使语言模型将视觉-模块调用编译为可执行的 Python; Visual Sketchpad (Hu等, 2024) 让多模式模型将中间结果外部化为所绘制的图像. 这些系统会产生文本答案. 在语言方面,程序辅助推理(Gao等,2023;Chen等,2023)和代码作为政策(Liang等,2023)显示,向口译员卸载计算可以提高算术的可靠性并体现任务. 现成的终端编码代理件——用于迭代读取文件,执行命令并针对出错修改程序的工具——是本行工作的当前体现. 评价模式遵循SWE-bench和SWE-agent(Jimenez等人,2024年;Yang等人,2024年):每例一个沙箱容器,一次尝试,由核查人决定. 最近一组工作使用代码来制作视觉内容,大多数情况下循环中没有基因视频模型. Kubrick (He et al., 2024a) 协调编导,程序员和编审代理,负责编写Blender脚本来提供文本描述的视频,并在FVD,FID,CLIP相似性和用户研究中超越了7个文本到视频基线. VIGA (Yin等,2026年)通过渲染和检查回路将参考图像重建为可执行的3D场景,并辅以目的所建技能库和外部资产生成器,再通过物理引擎模拟4D物理动态. BVB (Tang等, 2026) 以视频理解为目标:代理重建真实室内视频为动画 Blender的场景在一个共享的带子下,由VLM评委打出分数和一个潜在-同质度的度量标准,最佳配置只保留了源视频中大约一半的瞬间事实,尽管存在高度的相似性. VideoCoCo (Li等, 2026) 取而代之的是保留了视频模型:一个编码代理写出一个Blender程序,其模拟草稿条件为光现实主义合成的基因视频引擎. 我们的环境在三个方面与所有四个不同。 首先,目标是一个可核查的推理基准,其中第一个框架和迅速确定答案,因此正确性由确定性评价者决定,而不是由分配度量衡,用户研究或VLM判断. 其次,代理是现成的命令行工具,不加修改使用,没有目的所构建的技能库,资产检索或图像或视频生成模型,它们直接用标准成像库来编写像素,而不是通过3D引擎来渲染. 第三,代理商在与视频模型相同的领导板上得分,包括接受基准本身培训的模型,这样可以直接将两条路线与同一项任务相比较.

blocks.en: This appendix presents supplementary analyses of the closed agents’ interaction traces and of the structural properties of the programs they generate. These analyses characterise how the three agents differ in their observable behaviour and working style. They do not bear directly on the main comparison between coding agents and video models, and they are placed here so as not to disrupt the flow of the primary results.
blocks.zh: 本附录对封闭剂的相互作用痕迹及其产生的程序的结构特性进行了补充分析。 这些分析说明这三种代理人在可观察到的行为和工作风格方面有何不同。 它们并不直接影响编码剂和视频模型之间的主要比较,它们被放在这里,以免扰乱主要结果的流通.

blocks.en: D.1 Tool-Use Profiles
blocks.zh: D.1 工具用途简介

blocks.en: Although the three closed agents face identical tasks under identical sandbox conditions, they follow markedly different solution paths. Codex tends to rely directly on its multimodal image input to interpret the first frame and typically begins writing code after only a small number of pixel-level probes. Claude Code pursues a more methodical approach, combining direct visual inspection with pixel-level measurement and frequently re-examining its own rendered output after generating the initial program. Gemini CLI rarely opens the image file directly; it instead reconstructs the content of the scene through scripts that programmatically inspect pixel values across the image, and it invokes OCR when the task requires extracting textual information.
blocks.zh: 虽然三个被关闭的代理在相同的沙盒条件下面临相同的任务,但它们遵循的解决方案路径明显不同. Codex倾向于直接依赖其多模式图像输入来解释第一个帧,一般只在少量像素级探测器后开始写入代码. Claude Code追求一种更加有条不紊的方法,将直接的视觉检查与像素水平的测量相结合,并经常在生成初始程序后重新审视它自己得到的输出. 双子座 CLI 很少直接打开图像文件;而是通过程序上检查整个图像的像素值的脚本来重建场景内容,当任务需要提取文字信息时,它引用OCR.

blocks.en: To characterise these differences systematically, we classify every tool call in the 1,500 closed-agent traces into one of several capability categories: image viewing, pixel probing, OCR, code authoring, program rendering, output checking, package installation and environment setup. As Figure 5 illustrates, each agent maintains a relatively stable distribution of tool use across the five task categories, while the three agents exhibit clearly distinct overall profiles. Quantitatively, Claude Code averages 2.8 image view operations and 3.3 pixel probe operations per task, and it verifies its own rendered output on 94.0% of tasks; Codex performs self-verification on only 13.8% of tasks. Gemini CLI averages 17.1 pixel probe operations per task while opening the image file directly on fewer than 2.0% of tasks. Notably, all 53 package installation events observed across the three trace sets are performed by Gemini CLI, reflecting its systematic tendency to extend its information-processing capabilities through external libraries rather than through direct image access. Task content nonetheless modulates the activation of specific capabilities: OCR, for example, is invoked on 13.0% of Knowledge tasks but on none of the Perception tasks. The overall tool-use composition thus functions primarily as a signature of agent-level behaviour, while the selective invocation of particular capabilities is additionally shaped by the demands of the specific task.
blocks.zh: 为了系统地描述这些差异,我们将1500个闭合剂痕迹中的每一个工具调用分类为几个能力类别之一:图像查看,像素检测,OCR,代码编写,程序渲染,输出检查,包安装和环境设置. 如图5所显示的,每种制剂在五个任务类别中都保持相对稳定的工具使用分布,而三种制剂显示出明显不同的总体特征。 从数量上看,克洛德代码平均每项任务平均2.8个图像查看操作和3.3个像素探测操作,它验证了94.0%任务上自己实现的输出;而克洛德代码则只对13.8%的任务进行自我验证. 双子座 CLI 平均每个任务17.1像素探测操作,而直接打开图像文件的任务不到2.0%. 值得注意的是,在三套跟踪设备中观察到的所有53个软件包安装活动都是由双子星CLI进行的,这反映出它有系统地通过外部图书馆而不是通过直接图像访问来扩大其信息处理能力的趋势。 尽管如此,任务内容仍调节了特定能力的启动:例如,13.0%的知识任务中援引OCR,但没有一项概念任务援引OCR。 因此,总体工具使用构成主要是作为代理人一级行为的标志,而选择性地援引特定能力则因具体任务的要求而有额外影响。

blocks.en: D.2 Temporal Structure of Agent Sessions
blocks.zh: D.2 代理会议的时间结构

blocks.en: All three agents follow the same broad pattern of perceiving the task before committing to a program, but they differ substantially in the timing of the transition from information gathering to program construction and in the degree to which the two phases overlap. The median number of tool calls made before the first write to solve.py is 3 for Codex, 7 for Claude Code and 19 for Gemini CLI, indicating that what each agent considers sufficient information to begin implementation varies considerably across the three systems.
blocks.zh: 这三个代理人在承诺实施一个方案之前都遵循同样广泛的理解任务模式,但它们在从信息收集到程序构建的过渡时间和两个阶段重叠的程度上大相径庭. 第一次写入前的工具调用中位数 。 py是Codex的3个,Claude Code的7个和双子座CLI的19个,说明每个代理人认为可以开始执行的足够信息在三个系统中差异很大.

blocks.en: Dividing each session into early, middle and late phases reveals three qualitatively distinct temporal trajectories. Codex exhibits little evidence of discrete phase transitions: having acquired the information it judges necessary, it typically writes the complete program and submits the solution in a trajectory that is close to a single pass, with minimal iteration. Claude Code, by contrast, displays a pronounced inspect–author–verify structure: its early phase is dominated by viewing and measuring the task image, the middle phase by program construction, and the late phase by visual verification of its own rendered output, with 56% of late-session tool calls consisting of image view operations. Gemini CLI shows no clear boundary between the perception and coding phases: pixel probing continues throughout the session, interleaved with successive program updates, and it performs on average approximately 3.4 code-writing or revision operations per task, yielding a probe-and-adjust trajectory that is iterative rather than staged. The three agents thus differ not only in the composition of their tool use but in the temporal organisation of information gathering, program construction and output verification, which persists consistently across task categories and instances.
blocks.zh: 将每场会议分为早期、中期和后期阶段,揭示出三个质量不同的时间轨迹。 Codex显示的离散相过渡的证据很少:在获取了它判断所需的信息后,它通常会写出完整的程序并提交一个接近单一通路的轨迹中的溶液,其迭代度最小. 相形之下,克洛德代码显示一个显著的检查 - author - 验证结构:其早期阶段以查看和测量任务图像为主,中间阶段以程序构建为主,后阶段以视觉验证自身输出为主,56%的后会场工具呼叫由图像视图操作组成. 双子座CLI在感知相和编码相之间没有明显的分界线:像素探测在整个会话中持续进行,与相继的程序更新相接相接,平均每任务进行大约3.4个代码写入或修订操作,产生一个迭代而非相接的探测和正轨. 因此,这三种代理人不仅在工具使用的组成方面,而且在信息收集、程序构建和产出核查的时间安排方面各不相同,这在各种任务类别和实例中始终存在。

blocks.en: D.3 Program Structure by Category
blocks.zh: D.3 按类别分列的方案结构

blocks.en: The internal structure of the agents’ programs varies systematically across task categories, complementing the distinction between depictive and propositional programs in Section 3.4 . In Spatiality , 39% of programs contain explicit combinatorial search—breadth-first search or shortest-path algorithms—indicating that a substantial fraction of spatial tasks reduce to discrete path-planning problems, which are more naturally expressed as search than as pixel manipulation. Knowledge is the only category in which numerical physics simulation is prominent, with approximately 14% of programs using discrete time steps, velocity components and restitution coefficients to model the required dynamics. Abstraction exhibits the highest rate of direct pixel copying, at approximately 17%: in several Raven-style tasks, programs copy pixel regions verbatim from one matrix cell to another, preserving the colour and stroke of the original rather than redrawing the shape procedurally. Together, these differences indicate that task categories correspond not only to different modes of reasoning, in the sense of Section 3.4 , but also to distinct computational strategies within the programs.
blocks.zh: 代理商方案的内部结构因任务类别而有系统差异,补充了第3.4节描述性和命题性方案之间的区别。 在空间性中,39%的程序包含明确的组合搜索-breadth-first搜索或最短路径算法,说明空间任务中很大一部分被缩小为离散路径规划问题,这些更自然地被表示为搜索而非像素操纵. 知识是数字物理模拟突出的唯一类别,大约14%的程序使用离散的时间步骤,速度组件和还原系数来模拟所需的动态. 抽象显示直接像素复制率最高,约为17%:在一些Raven风格的任务中,程序将像素区域从一个矩阵单元格逐字复制到另一个矩阵单元格,保留原色和中风,而不是按程序重绘形状. 这些差异加在一起表明,任务类别不仅与3.4节意义上的不同推理模式相对应,而且与程序内部不同的计算策略相对应.

blocks.en: Figure 6 illustrates a depictive program on G-161, which asks for a red ring around the second largest of several circles. Codex receives the first frame as an image attachment and makes two tool calls, the first listing the directory and reading the prompt and the second writing and running the program. In its message it names the answer in prose (“the medium-sized circle at the lower right”), but the program makes no use of that sentence. It thresholds the frame on colour saturation, labels the connected components, sorts them by pixel area and takes the second (lines 5–10); the centre and radius of the ring come from that component’s bounding box (lines 10–12). The only numbers written into the code are the saturation threshold, the ring’s margin and width, and the frame count. Re-executed on instance 00001, which has four circles of other sizes, colours and positions, the program rings the second largest again and scores 1.0, although its own comment still speaks of “three filled circles”. All 15 closed-agent programs for G-161 behave this way under the transfer test: 12 transfer with score 1.0 and 3 crash on the new frame; none draws its old answer. The run uses 780 output tokens.
blocks.zh: 图6显示了G-161上的一个描绘性方案,它要求一个红环围绕几个圆圈中的第二大圆圈. Codex作为图像附件接收了第一个帧,并发出两个工具呼叫,第一个是列出目录并读取快取,第二个是写和运行程序. 在其信息中,它用道词( " 右下角的中度圆 " )命名答案,但程序没有使用这句话。 它以颜色饱和度为框架的阈值,标出相接组件,按像素区域排序并取出第二(行5-10);环的中心和半径取自该组件的边框(行10-12). 写入代码的唯一数字是饱和阈值,环的比值和宽度,以及帧数. 以0001为例重新执行,它有四个其他大小、颜色和位置的圆圈,程序再次响起第二大圈并得分为1.0分,尽管它自己的评论仍然提到“三个填满的圆圈”。 G-161的所有15个封闭代理程序在转会测试下都这样做:12个转会,在新帧上得分为1.0分和3分崩溃;无一取出旧的答案. 该跑会使用780个输出符.

blocks.en: Figure 7 shows the Codex program for G-13, trimmed to the lines discussed here, a task that requires moving a sprite through a grid of numbered cells to the goal cell along a valid shortest path. Having probed the frame once to establish the bounding box of the sprite, Codex writes down the nine corner cells of the route directly from its visual reading of the image, annotating each leg with its Manhattan length as an inline comment, and then expands the sequence of corners into a full cell-by-cell trajectory. Each frame of the output video is constructed by taking the input image, erasing the sprite from its starting cell by restoring the background pixels, and re-stamping the sprite pixel-for-pixel at the interpolated position along the route, so that the grid itself—its numbers, lines and colouring—is never modified. The result is a video that is visually indistinguishable from one produced by a simulation of the physical task, obtained entirely by rendering the route the agent derived in its session.
blocks.zh: 图7显示了G-13的Codex程序,该程序被修剪到这里讨论的行上,这个任务需要沿着一个有效的最短路径,通过一个被编号的单元格的网格将一个图示移动到目标单元格. 在一次探勘了帧来建立"宝石"的边框后,Codex直接从图像的视觉读取中将路由的9个角细胞写下,用其曼哈顿长度来标注出每条腿作为内线评论,再将角的顺序扩展为完整的逐个细胞的轨迹. 输出视频的每个框架都是通过取入图像来构建的,通过还原背景像素来从起动的单元格中去除图样,再将图样像素换成像素在沿途的插入位置上重新打出,这样网格本身——它的编号,行和取色——就永远不会被修改. 结果是一段视频,与模拟物理任务制作的视频相去甚远,视频完全通过使代理在其会话中衍生的路由获得.

blocks.en: Figure 7 : The Codex program for G-13 (grid number sequence task, instance 00000; 3 tool calls, 20 s, score 1.0), shown alongside the task’s first frame and the final frame it renders. The nine corner cells of the route are written into the program as literals derived from the agent’s visual reading of the image, with each leg annotated by its Manhattan length. The sprite is erased from its starting cell and re-stamped pixel-for-pixel at each interpolated position along the route, leaving the board itself unchanged throughout the video.
blocks.zh: 图7: G- 13 的 Codex 程序( 格数序列任务, 例如 00000; 3个工具调用, 20 s, 分数 1.0) , 与任务的第一个框架和它制作的最后框架一起显示 。 路由的九个角细胞被写入程序,作为从代理对图像的视觉读取所衍生出的内容,每条腿由它的曼哈顿长度来注释. 斯匹克被从起动的细胞中去除,并在沿途的每个插入位置上再贴上像素-for-像素,使板本身在整个视频中保持不变.
